title: Zesty Indulgent Jamaican Tofu Wrap
description: A tangy, juicy tofu wrap wrapped in banana leaf, infused with Jamaican jerk spice, chives, and nuka-pickle for a vibrant, temple-friendly dish.
instructions: Heat a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat and splash 1 tsp sesame oil until shimmering.
Toss the cubed tofu in the jerk seasoning mix, lime juice, and soy sauce until all pieces are evenly coated.
Place the tofu in the hot skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side until golden brown and crispy.
While the tofu is browning, spread a thin layer of gochujang over each banana leaf sheet and sprinkle chopped chives on top.
Remove the tofu from the skillet and let it rest for 1 minute, then scatter diced nuka-pickle over the tofu cubes for added crunch.
Spoon a generous portion of tofu onto the center of each banana leaf, fold the edges inward, and roll tightly into a wrap shape.
Place the wrapped banana leaves in a steamer basket and steam for 5 minutes to meld the flavors and soften the leaf.
Carefully unwrap the banana leaf and transfer the wrap onto a serving plate.
Garnish with fresh chives and a squeeze of lime if desired for extra brightness.
Serve immediately while warm, enjoying the zesty, juicy flavors of Jamaican-inspired tofu.
